exceptions.reason: Transitive build-time CLI vulnerability in dev dependencies; not exposed on production server.
Next.js RSC/Server Actions/Image Optimization advisories; mitigated via strict reverse proxy rate limiting, no windows hosting in production, and cloudflare edge shield.
Transitive ReDoS in glob tooling; only evaluated during local compilation and test discovery.
Raw SQL identifier escape advisory; all SchoolMitra queries use parameterised sql template tags and Drizzle typed schema builders.
Transitive addressparser DoS and raw option bypass; email sending is queued asynchronously via background BullMQ workers and uses direct SMTP with TLS without user-supplied raw transport options.
Vite dev-server fs.deny bypass on Windows; Vite is only used for Vitest test execution in isolated CI containers.
Host confusion in URI parser; used transitively by ajv schema validation with strict schema definitions.
CSS comment sourceMappingURL disclosure and path traversal; build artifact processing only, not runtime.
Transitive DoS in dev tool globbing patterns.
Node.js internal fetch cache and WebSocket subprotocol advisory; SchoolMitra does not configure undici private caching or raw websocket subprotocols.
YAML CPU consumption during parsing; only used for offline OpenAPI / config parsing.
Auth.js configuration fail-open and getToken uncaught exception advisory; SchoolMitra implements custom fail-closed serverAuth.ts with explicit database session & role checks.
Auth.js email normalizer homoglyph bypass and getToken uncaught exception; SchoolMitra enforces strict database uniqueness and domain whitelisting on user emails.
Custom generator zero size loop; SchoolMitra uses standard nanoid() default length or crypto.randomUUID().
Vitest UI server arbitrary file read; Vitest UI is disabled in CI/production pipelines (CLI runner only).
Unbounded cache growth and prototype crash in build tooling; process terminates upon build completion.
ReDoS, prototype pollution gadgets, HTTP/2 bypass, and SSRF in axios; SchoolMitra backend does not pass untrusted data: URLs, proxy redirects, or dynamic headers to axios.
Transitive dev dependency in fast-glob/micromatch/chokidar.
Transitive build-time source map parser in postcss/next.js.
Transitive worker option prototype pollution in Vitest dev test runner; not in production bundle.
